class.name: OcgIntres2dDomain
class.brief_description: Definition of the domain of parameter on a 2d-curve. Most of the time, a domain is defined by two extremities. An extremity is made of : - a point in 2d-space (Pnt2d from gp), - a parameter on the curve, - a tolerance in the 2d-space. Sometimes, it can be made of 0 or 1 point ( for an infinite or semi-infinite line for example).
class.description: ! Definition of the domain of parameter on a 2d-curve. ! Most of the time, a domain is defined by two extremities. ! An extremity is made of : ! - a point in 2d-space (Pnt2d from gp), ! - a parameter on the curve, ! - a tolerance in the 2d-space. ! Sometimes, it can be made of 0 or 1 point ( for an infinite ! or semi-infinite line for example). ! ! For Intersection algorithms, Ellipses and Circles ! Domains must be closed. ! So, SetEquivalentParameters(.,.) method must be called ! after initializing the first and the last bounds.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an infinite Domain (HasFirstPoint = False and HasLastPoint = False).

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a semi-infinite Domain. If First is set to True, the given point is the first point of the domain, otherwise it is the last point.

method.name: SetValues_3
method.description: Sets the values for a bounded domain.

method.name: SetValues_1
method.description: Sets the values for an infinite domain.

method.name: SetValues_2
method.description: Sets the values for a semi-infinite domain.

method.name: HasFirstPoint
method.description: Returns True if the domain has a first point, i-e a point defining the lowest admitted parameter on the curve.

method.name: FirstParameter
method.description: Returns the parameter of the first point of the domain The exception DomainError is raised if HasFirstPoint returns False.

method.name: FirstPoint
method.description: Returns the first point of the domain. The exception DomainError is raised if HasFirstPoint returns False.

method.name: FirstTolerance
method.description: Returns the tolerance of the first (left) bound. The exception DomainError is raised if HasFirstPoint returns False.

method.name: HasLastPoint
method.description: Returns True if the domain has a last point, i-e a point defining the highest admitted parameter on the curve.

method.name: LastParameter
method.description: Returns the parameter of the last point of the domain. The exception DomainError is raised if HasLastPoint returns False.

method.name: LastPoint
method.description: Returns the last point of the domain. The exception DomainError is raised if HasLastPoint returns False.

method.name: LastTolerance
method.description: Returns the tolerance of the last (right) bound. The exception DomainError is raised if HasLastPoint returns False.

method.name: IsClosed
method.description: Returns True if the domain is closed.

method.name: EquivalentParameters
method.description: Returns Equivalent parameters if the domain is closed. Otherwise, the exception DomainError is raised.
